description_en: Queries the inter-region bandwidth information between regions by calling the DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits接口查询各个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽的信息
name: DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the region information corresponding to a region ID
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID对应的地域信息
parameters.name: tr_region_id

CenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_en: The list of inter-region bandwidth information
CenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_zh: 跨地域互通带宽信息列表

BandwidthLimit.description_en: The inter-region bandwidth between the two regions. Unit: Mbit/s
BandwidthLimit.description_zh: 两个地域间的跨地域互通带宽。单位：Mbps

BandwidthType.description_en:
The bandwidth allocation method. Valid values:

BandwidthPackage: bandwidth is allocated from a bandwidth package.

DataTransfer: no bandwidth is allocated to the inter-region connection. Data transfer is pay-by-traffic
BandwidthType.description_zh:
带宽的分配方式。取值：

BandwidthPackage：从带宽包中分配带宽。

DataTransfer：不为跨地域连接分配带宽，按使用流量计费

GeographicSpanId.description_en: The ID of the connected areas

LocalRegionId.description_en:
The ID of the local region.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html） operation to query the region information corresponding to a region ID
LocalRegionId.description_zh:
本端地域ID。

您可以调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html）接口获取地域ID对应的地域信息

OppositeRegionId.description_en: The ID of the peer region

Status.description_en:
The status of the inter-region bandwidth. Valid values:

Active: running.

Modifying: being modified
Status.description_zh:
跨地域互通带宽的状态。取值：

Active：运行中。

Modifying：修改中

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page when using paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数
